text:
maya: Found a tiny origami crane on the kitchen counter with a sticky note: 'For whoever needs a win today.' Felt cute.
lin: That was me. Made a dozen this morning. Leave them where people will find them.
rachel: Instant morale boost. Also: who packed the mystery granola bar with almond whisper? (it fought valiantly)
dan: GIF: <link_to_success-crane.gif> caption: 'When a small thing saves your day'
maya: Shoutout to lin for low-effort high-impact kindness. :sparkles:
lin: Also shoutout to rachel for handling the client call yesterday like a pro. Team email incoming with details.
tidy-bot: Reminder: kitchen counters should be cleared by 6pm daily. Decorative items are allowed if labeled. (automated)
rachel: Vote: keep the origami corner by the window or distribute them randomly? :one: corner :two: scatter
dan: :two: scatter. Surprise joy is a competitive advantage.
maya: I'm in for a mini origami station this Friday at 4pm. BYO paper or grab some from the supply shelf.
lin: I'll bring a tiny how-to sheet and extra patience. Also: tiny tape for sticky notes.
tidy-bot: PSA: please don't tape paper to the monitor screens. (automated, with love)
dan: Outcome: origami station scheduled, scatter strategy wins, kudos thread for lin and rachel. If anyone finds a crane in their shoe, it's a goodwill deposit.
maya: Thread closed unless the cranes unionize. :crane: :heart:
